answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 27643 Country: India Title: If any Mukhtadi repeats the same Qirat with the imam slowly not in mind but by opening his mouth,then how is it. Question: As salamo alaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.If any Mukhtadi repeats the same Qirat with the imam slowly not in mind but by opening his mouth,then how is it. Answer ID: 27643 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1840/L=518/tl=1431) It is makrooh tahrimi and unlawful for muqtadi to do Qirah: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ الْقُرْآنُ فَاسْتَمِعُواْ لَهُ وَأَنصِتُواْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ [الأعراف : 204] Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
